$comment: Digital product specs for Room 1 (productType "digital", owner 2026-10-16). EMPTY until the owner picks a niche from the research (station-workspace/research-lab/scouting/). One entry per product type; the package gate checks every deliverable set against its entry. Agents read a copy (seed.mjs).

$schema.key: lowercase id used as a brief's product_type, e.g. "bingo-printable-set"
$schema.digital: true (required): no production cost, no shipping; floor = Etsy fees + minimum margin
$schema.licence: a key of config.digital.licences: personal-use | commercial-standard | commercial-content

deliverables.files: [{ "format": "png|jpg", "widthPx": n, "heightPx": n, "purpose": "what the buyer uses it for" }]: the exact set; count <= config.digital.etsyFileLimits.maxFiles, or, with package, the exact contents of the zip
deliverables.package: optional { "kind": "zip", "preview": true }: the station builds the deliverables from the Designer's raw files (set-vN/raw/): ONE zip holding exactly `files`, the listing's only download (owner, 2026-10-16). With preview: true it also makes a preview image (config.digital.build.preview) in set-vN/listing/: a listing photo, never a download file.
deliverables.prep: optional { "cleanup": true, "upscale": "realesrgan" }: what the station does to each raw file before it goes into the zip (config.digital.build); the package gate requires a matching record for every delivered file
deliverables.note: printables: pixels = inches x 300 (e.g. US Letter 8.5x11 in = 2550x3300 px)

$schema.variants: optional [{ "label": "Digital download" }]; default one variant "Digital download"
$schema.listingNotice: optional { "text": "...", "status": "owner-approved YYYY-MM-DD" }: this product's digital-download notice (it may name the files), stated word for word; default config.digital.listingNotice
$schema.styleReference: optional { "ownerOk": true }: file 1 is drawn alone first and approved by the owner (run-line --first-file, scripts/style-ref.mjs), then sent to the image model as the style reference for every other file (run-line --after-style-ok); the package gate requires the approved file 1 in the build
$schema.priceFloorUsd: optional { "value": n, "decidedBy": "owner", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD" }: the owner's price floor for this product in USD, used instead of the fee-model digital floor by every price check (brief check, intake, the scout's brief check, the price fill, the package gate). A minimum: prices may be higher when the evidence supports it.
$schema.aspectRatio: the image generator's aspect ratio for the main artwork, e.g. "3:4"
$schema.transparent: true | false: whether the generator draws on a transparent background

products.status: Owner, 2026-10-16: niche #4 picked. Delivered as ONE zip of the 12 PNGs, the only download; the preview image is a listing photo only (owner, 2026-10-16). Licence commercial-content and the digital-download notice owner-approved, image model's commercial use owner-confirmed (2026-10-16). File 1 is drawn alone and approved by the owner before files 2-12 (styleReference); no other runs without the owner's go.
products.licenceNote: Owner, 2026-10-16: the commercial licence, reworded for streamers (no merchandise or print-on-demand); the personal-use licence is dropped for this pack.

listingNotice.text: This is a digital download. Nothing will be shipped. You'll receive one ZIP file containing 12 transparent PNG files (2000×2000 px). The files are available to download from Etsy once payment is confirmed.

priceFloorUsd.note: OWNER D1 17/10/2026 (DECISIONS.md 'E6 step c0'): USD 3.50 (was USD 7.19, the fee-model digital floor with the EUR 5 minimum margin). A minimum: agents may price higher when the evidence supports it. At USD 3.50 = EUR 3.13 the margin after Etsy fees incl. VAT is EUR 2.14 (fees EUR 0.99), below the EUR 5 minimum margin of the fee model.

styleReference.note: Owner go 2026-10-16: file 1 (the steaming mug) is generated alone, the owner sees it flattened on light and dark and approves it, then it is the image model's style reference for files 2-12.

files.purpose: prop 1 of 12: transparent prop placed beside the buyer's avatar in a stream scene
colour variant 1 of 2: a second colourway of one of props 1-10
colour variant 2 of 2: a second colourway of one of props 1-10

deliverables.note: 2000x2000 transparent PNG per prop (inside the zip): the size the owner recorded on a competitor listing (2026-10-16). The image generator drew 1024x1024 on earlier runs (measured 2026-10-16), so each raw file is cleaned up, trimmed, upscaled with Real-ESRGAN (alpha upscaled separately) and padded onto the 2000x2000 canvas by the station (config.digital.build).
